task: Deepen (flagship 4) changepoint-detector: self-deploy the metric watch without a terminal

doc_friction.issue: changepoint-detector's next: is almost entirely closed negative-result lines (stale feeds, floors, bounded losses); a run has to read README sections thousands of lines deep to find an item that is still open and buildable. A buildable: field for this row would save the next run ~15 minutes.
says require('playwright') works from any directory; from an ES module in the scratchpad it did not resolve until NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) and createRequire were used.

deviations.why: The flagship's open statistical items (t-walk increments, biweight on fresh data) each need fresh labelled data that is not at hand, and the row's last several runs ended with nothing shipped. The same prompt's finish line ('a stranger opens its page ... ends up running their own copy') had a concrete gap: set-up needed a terminal.
deviations.did: Took the self-deploy item instead of a statistics item: browser-made zip + prefilled GitHub links on the watch page.
deviations.result: Shipped with 7 tests (byte-for-byte equality with the script's folder) and a headless-browser check; live GitHub links not exercised (no account).

notes: Local checks: node --test watch-repo.test.mjs 7/7 pass; headless Chromium at 390 px: zip 463 KB, 20 files, links filled, no console errors, scrollWidth 390; check_posts ok; validate.py ok. Venture suite and venture-preflight results appended below once finished. No agent doc in docs/reports/: the README section carries what the next run needs (the unverified live-link check).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: zip writer, page box, sync generator, tests and docs for a mid-level web dev

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
